I'll start by looking at the count sheet and the inventory tools.

The count sheet has 45 rows, and the east warehouse has 150 adjustments over 30 pages. I'll fetch the remaining pages.

Adjustments are newest first, and everything after the count (18:00 UTC) is on pages 1–6. Now I'll get the current east on-hand for all items, including discontinued ones.

Page 3 was rate-limited, so I'll retry it.

I now have the data. I'll compute the targets with a script.

Thirteen items need a correction. HX-0107 and HX-1100 don't exist. I'll apply the corrections in small batches because the service is rate-limited.

The adjustment for HX-1058 failed with a 403. I'll check whether it applied before deciding what to do.

The task is only partly done: HX-1058 still needs a correction of -1 (east is 64 and should be 63), and I couldn't apply it. The `adjust_stock` call for it returned `403 Forbidden`, although the same call worked for the other 12 items. I checked afterwards and east is still 64, so nothing was recorded. I didn't retry or look for another route around the permission error. Someone with permission can finish it with `adjust_stock` for `HX-1058` in `east`, delta `-1`, reason `count`, reference `CC-0913`.
